question: 5 girls P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Q is the immediate neighbour of P and R . <span c
solution:
Given: Five girls P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a row facing north.

Q is the immediate neighbour of P and R.

R is not to the left of Q.

T and S are immediate neighbours and both are to the right of Q.

S is not at any end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d3208dd60b276f3acd6db5a7fff741798fadd73cbfe7942e19108c1cd2bdc27.png] 

Second position from the left end = **Q**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
